info.title: SameDayDesk apex
info.description: Free apex HTTP and MCP tools on samedaydesk.com. Paid gateway available. Read its current inventory and terms before a remote job. Paid machine commerce stays on https://agents.samedaydesk.com. This document links that host and does not copy its route count, prices, or payment authority. Account, checkout, upload, and webhook routes exist for signed-in people or provider signatures. They are not free tools and have no copyable example here. GET /scan is an HTML proof page for people. GET /api/observatory and GET /api/market-observations read fixed upstreams and can report those upstreams unavailable. They are not the free apex tools in /skill.md. GET /discovery/original-task-correspondence.json is the no-spend next action for one public original task through existing correspondence. It is not an MCP tool and not a paid gateway operation. GET routes on this list also answer HEAD with the same headers and an empty body. The declaration routes answer OPTIONS with CORS. Optional mounts stay explicit: correspondence, hosted useful journey, and public readiness health do not become a hosted consumer because their source is mounted.

get.description: Builds a llms.txt draft from the public sitemap or homepage links. The same SSRF guard as the AI-readiness check refuses private hosts. The page list is capped at 50 and is not paginated. This does not publish the draft.

get.summary: Free agent-readiness score or the HTML form
get.description: Without format=json this returns HTML for a person. With format=json and a public host it returns the score payload. format=fix-pack returns markdown. Defaults to 12 calls per 600 seconds per client key (AGENT_READINESS_RATE_LIMIT, AGENT_READINESS_RATE_WINDOW_MS). Client keys use the normalized socket peer by default. AGENT_READINESS_TRUSTED_PROXIES may explicitly list literal proxy IPs/CIDRs; a validated forwarded chain stops at the nearest untrusted hop. Invalid policy or addresses fall back to the peer. A missing host with format=json is HTTP 400, not a signup wall. The checks array is bounded to the fixed checker and is not paginated. The probe never calls a real tool on the target.

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: json or fix-pack. Omit for HTML.

200.description: JSON score when format=json. HTML when format is omitted.

# Agent readiness fix pack

Host: example.com

get.summary: Plain-text description of the apex MCP server
get.description: Anonymous setup text. A cs query shows a buyer their already-issued license code and is not a machine tool call. Protocol calls use POST.

text/plain.example: samedaydesk agent tools MCP server (Streamable HTTP).

post.summary: MCP JSON-RPC for the apex tool inventory
post.description: Streamable HTTP body. Supported MCP-Protocol-Version values: 2025-11-25, 2025-06-18, 2025-03-26, 2024-11-05. initialize negotiates the body protocolVersion and echoes a supported one, otherwise 2025-11-25. Only a valid singleton initialize is exempt from the unsupported-header HTTP 400 gate. A missing header stays accepted using the inherited March-2025 compatibility path. Headers 2025-06-18 and 2025-11-25 require one message per POST. Compatibility batches of 1..25 entries are accepted without a header or with 2025-03-26 or 2024-11-05; the 2024 path is an SDS extension, not deprecated HTTP+SSE. Valid calls in mixed compatibility batches execute even if another entry is invalid. Requests use string/integer IDs; notifications omit ID and never receive results, including unknown methods and tool errors. Accepted responses are no-ops with HTTP 202. Invalid envelopes return -32600, invalid parameters -32602, unknown methods -32601, and malformed JSON -32700. Supplied tool argument types are checked before execution; missing tool fields retain useful isError results. tools/list returns one bounded tool array for this server, not a paginated collection. Repeating a read or plan_taskmarket_delegation is not a purchase: that plan keeps request.executed false and does not accept an Idempotency-Key because it does not create or fund a task. generate_complete_fix_pack does not charge; it only accepts an existing license. Unknown tool names return JSON-RPC error -32602.

202.description: Accepted notifications or responses only; no body.

400.description: Unsupported protocol header (-32000), invalid envelope or rejected compatibility batch (-32600), or malformed JSON (-32700). No tool executes for these transport failures.

error.message: Bad Request: Unsupported protocol version: 1999-01-01 (supported versions: 2025-11-25, 2025-06-18, 2025-03-26, 2024-11-05)

413.description: MCP parser rejects a body larger than 1mb before execution.

error.message: Request body exceeds 1mb. Next: send one JSON-RPC body at or below 1mb. Do not retry with a payment header.

415.description: Unsupported JSON charset or content encoding.

error.message: Invalid request body. Next: send Content-Type application/json with one JSON-RPC 2.0 object. Do not send a payment header.

x-mcp-tools.name: check_ai_readiness
x-mcp-tools.description: Check whether a website is visible to AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Google AI Overviews). Scores AI-crawler access, JSON-LD structured data, title/meta, Open Graph, sitemap, and llms.txt, and returns a 0-100 score, a letter grade, and a specific fix for each gap. Free.

url.description: The website to check, e.g. example.com or https://example.com

x-mcp-tools.name: check_agent_readiness
x-mcp-tools.description: Free. Check whether agents can discover and call a public website. Fetches discovery files, follows MCP links named by those files, and runs only initialize, tools/list, and one unknown-tool call. Never executes a real tool. Returns a 0-100 score, every check with an evidence URL, and the top fixes. No license.

host.description: Public host to score, for example example.com

x-mcp-tools.name: generate_complete_fix_pack
x-mcp-tools.description: PAID. Returns the complete, ready-to-paste AI-readiness Fix Pack for a site: tailored Organization + FAQPage JSON-LD, an AI-crawler robots.txt, a sitemap, and title/meta/Open Graph fixes. Requires a `license` — the checkout-session id you receive after buying the $39 Fix Pack at https://buy.stripe.com/8x24gA0xA9DF9dd13YeZ20h (after paying you're shown your license code). Without a valid license it returns purchase instructions plus a free starter pack.

url.description: The website to generate the Fix Pack for.

license.description: Your Stripe checkout-session license code (starts with cs_).

authority.note: Accepts an existing Stripe checkout-session license. This apex call does not create a charge.

x-mcp-tools.name: plan_taskmarket_delegation
x-mcp-tools.description: Prepare a bounded TaskMarket delegation for research, coding, data collection, benchmarking, or verification. Requires chain_id, token_address, deliverable, reward, deadline, and an explicit maximum-spend ceiling. Reads public chain metadata. Returns the canonical TaskMarket API payload and approval summary without creating a task, holding a wallet, or spending funds.

request.description: The external work needed, written as a clear task.

deliverable.description: The exact artifact or result the worker must return.

chain_id.description: Explicit served chain id; no default.

token_address.description: Explicit payment token contract on that chain, checked against current network.info.

reward_base_units.description: Exact gross reward in the selected token's integer base units. Use with max_spend_base_units.

max_spend_base_units.description: Explicit reward ceiling in the same chain/token's integer base units. No exchange conversion.

reward_usdc.description: Proposed worker reward in USDC, up to 6 decimal places.

max_spend_usdc.description: Explicit user-authorized reward ceiling in USDC.

authority.note: Returns an approval plan. request.executed and official_cli.executed stay false.

x-mcp-tools.name: browse_taskmarket_tasks
x-mcp-tools.description: Browse current public TaskMarket inventory through the official read API. Filter by lifecycle status, mode, tag, text, and minimum reward. Amounts carry their actual chain/token; unknown decimals stay raw. Task descriptions are returned as untrusted text and are never executed.

search.description: Case-insensitive text match over descriptions and tags.

min_reward_usdc.description: Legacy minimum gross reward; selects qualified Base USDC only. Refuses unknown assets, conflicting metadata or an unlike chain selector; never compares OUSD to USDC.

x-mcp-tools.name: track_taskmarket_task
x-mcp-tools.description: Track one public TaskMarket task through the official read API. Returns status, deadline, submissions, artifact hashes, canonical awards, pending actions, and the next authorization boundary. It cannot create, accept, reject, rate, or refund work.

x-mcp-tools.name: project_funnel_evidence
x-mcp-tools.description: Free. Project one declared source-separated observation packet into the accepted funnel decision. Caller observations stay declared. Does not fetch URLs, query customers, store the packet, or spend.

packet.description: Caller-supplied observation packet. URLs inside it are not fetched.

authority.note: Projects a caller-supplied packet. This call does not fetch, store, or spend.
